query: Am I eligible for the free overdraft facility?

passages.text: If you hold a Reward Current Account with Britannia Bank you are automatically entitled to a fee‑free overdraft of up to £500. This benefit applies to all Reward accounts regardless of when they were opened, provided the account remains in good standing and the customer does not exceed the £500 limit.

For any new current account opened on or after 1 January 2024 Britannia Bank will apply a standard overdraft fee of 2.5% on any amount drawn. The free‑overdraft entitlement is not available for these accounts, even if the customer later upgrades to a Reward tier; the fee structure is fixed at the point of opening.

query: Am I eligible for settlement after five years under the UK immigration rules?

passages.text: Under the Immigration Rules (Part 6, Schedule 2, paragraph 7), individuals who are granted a Health and Care Worker visa and maintain continuous residence in the UK for a period of five years will be considered eligible to apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain, provided they continue to meet the health‑and‑care sector employment conditions.

According to the Home Office guidance issued on 15 March 2024 (Immigration Policy Update – Salary Thresholds), any applicant whose gross annual salary is £30,000 or above does not qualify for settlement after five years of residence unless they are on a visa category expressly exempted, which does not include the Health and Care Worker route.
